sessionRecovery: Local unpublished files and in-memory blob manifest were lost during maintenance. Approved V2 was recovered; this branch reapplies the finish and revalidates it. No old V3 counts are presented as current evidence.
beforeArchive: 22 V2 captures copied without image edits from approved repository evidence. Original 10 fixtures compare byte-for-byte equal to the first 10 V3 fixtures. Canonical report keeps provenance.
captures: Final tool freezes real save states, caps verification rendering at 10 Hz to avoid software renderer queue contention, checks clock/state invariance and writes a report after every shot. This cadence is not a performance measurement or production change.
initialNodeFailures: Initial reconstruction exceeded the geometry budget; a subsequent 29/31 focused run found a sill 0.015 m below the envelope and a ridge cap too close to the central roof. All corrected; logs retained.
initialBrowserFailures: Concurrent captures and focused tests produced two timeouts; isolated execution passed fallback and evacuation but found a reload assertion before the first Station LOD sync. Test waits for the restored camera LOD without relaxing assertions/timeouts. Logs retained.
omittedArtifacts: Original lost V3 files and captures cannot be independently verified in this resumed workspace.
Preliminary REVIEW PNGs and interrupted full BEFORE/AFTER duplicate PNGs are not canonical; only logs/reports where available are retained.
Concurrent timeout traces/screenshots were overwritten by the following focused execution; raw JSON error/attachment path records are retained.
scope: No complete browser suite, integration, main change, deployment, bridge structural merge or hardware FPS claim.

finalValidation.browser: Three focused cases PASS across isolated 2-pass group plus corrected quality 1-pass group; no retries/skips
finalValidation.visual: 34 pairs/68 originals, identical frozen state; all inspected

captureNavigationTimeout: Initial AFTER loop completed 29 shots before page.goto 30 s timeout. Capture-only navigation timeout changed to 120 s; resumed just five missing shots. All 34 final shots are error-free.
